settings.heading: Art, with a life beyond the canvas.
settings.introduction: A Naga City boutique bringing original artworks into modern Filipiniana clothing.

settings.heading: A painted-fashion point of view.
settings.copy: TCPF is owned and operated by Tisha Chavez. The boutique prints original paintings and artworks onto modern Filipiniana clothing, giving expressive imagery a place in the everyday wardrobe.
